The Pads API (see the [guide](/guides/api/)). Each procedure is in Odin as
`pads_api.name`, in C as `pads_name` (through the function table
`Pads_Api_V1`), and over the control socket as the method `pads_name`.

## The handle, results, threading and versions

### api_post

```odin
api_post :: proc(api: ^Api, call: Post_Proc, user: rawptr) -> Result
```

Queues `call` to run on the control thread at the next frame, with `user`. Any thread. Its results come back however `user` says (the call writes them there, say).

### api_version

```odin
api_version :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

The API's version (`VERSION`).

### last_error

```odin
last_error :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

Why the last call that failed failed, in words (temporary: until the next failure). "" before any.

## History: undo, redo, groups, gestures

### history_state

```odin
history_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (History_State, Result)
```

The history now.

### history_undo

```odin
history_undo :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Undoes the last step. Not_Found with nothing to undo; Busy while a group is open.

### history_redo

```odin
history_redo :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Redoes the last step undone. Not_Found with nothing to redo; Busy while a group is open.

### history_undo_name

```odin
history_undo_name :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

What undo would undo ("Set Tempo"), or "" (temporary).

### history_redo_name

```odin
history_redo_name :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

What redo would redo, or "" (temporary).

### history_step_name

```odin
history_step_name :: proc(api: ^Api, step: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Step `step`'s name, counting along the history: 0 .. undo_steps-1 are the steps done (the oldest first), then the steps undone (the next to redo first). Not_Found past the end. Temporary.

### history_go_to

```odin
history_go_to :: proc(api: ^Api, done: i64) -> Result
```

Undoes or redoes until `done` steps are done (0: all undone; undo_steps + redo_steps: all redone). Invalid_Argument out of that range; Busy while a group is open.

### history_group_begin

```odin
history_group_begin :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> Result
```

Starts a group: the edits until `history_group_end` become one undo step named `name`. Groups nest (the outermost names the step).

### history_group_end

```odin
history_group_end :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Ends the group `history_group_begin` started (an empty group leaves no step). Not_Found when none is open.

### history_gesture_begin

```odin
history_gesture_begin :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Starts a gesture (a knob or a fader held): the edits of one value until `history_gesture_end` merge into one undo step, as a drag's do. Without one, each edit is a step of its own.

### history_gesture_end

```odin
history_gesture_end :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Ends the gesture: the next edit is a new step.

## Project: new, open, save, templates, clean up

### project_state

```odin
project_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Project_State, Result)
```

The project now.

### project_dir

```odin
project_dir :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

The project's folder (an untitled one's is in the unsaved folder). Temporary.

### project_name

```odin
project_name :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (string, Result)
```

The project's name: its folder's, without ".pads" ("Untitled" before it is saved). Temporary.

### project_new

```odin
project_new :: proc(api: ^Api, discard_changes: bool) -> Result
```

A new, empty project. With changes not saved, Busy unless `discard_changes` (they are lost; an untitled project's folder goes).

### project_new_from_template

```odin
project_new_from_template :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string, discard_changes: bool) -> Result
```

A new, untitled project from the template called `name`. Not_Found if there is none; Busy with changes not saved unless `discard_changes`.

### project_open

```odin
project_open :: proc(api: ^Api, dir: string, discard_changes: bool) -> Result
```

Opens the project in folder `dir`. Not_Found if there is none there; Busy with changes not saved unless `discard_changes`.

### project_save

```odin
project_save :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Saves the project where it is (an untitled one stays untitled, in the unsaved folder: `project_save_as` gives it a place).

### project_save_as

```odin
project_save_as :: proc(api: ^Api, path: string, replace: bool = false) -> Result
```

Saves the project as folder `path` (".pads" added when missing), which it is from now on. Invalid_Argument if something is there already, unless `replace` (the project is written into that folder).

### project_rename

```odin
project_rename :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> Result
```

Renames the project's folder to "<name>.pads", where it is. Unsupported for an untitled project (save it as); Invalid_Argument for a name a folder can't have, or one taken.

### project_recent

```odin
project_recent :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Recent project `index`'s folder (0: the latest). Temporary.

### project_template_name

```odin
project_template_name :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Template `index`'s name (in name order). Temporary.

### project_save_template

```odin
project_save_template :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> Result
```

Saves a copy of the project as template `name` (one of that name is replaced). New projects can start from it.

### project_recover

```odin
project_recover :: proc(api: ^Api, dir: string) -> Result
```

Opens the backup the project in `dir` left when Pads stopped without closing (its changes, not yet saved). Not_Found if it left none.

### project_discard_backup

```odin
project_discard_backup :: proc(api: ^Api, dir: string) -> Result
```

Throws away the backup the project in `dir` left (an unsaved project's folder with it).

### project_unused_files

```odin
project_unused_files :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Unused_Files, Result)
```

The files in the project's folder it doesn't use now, by kind.

### project_clean_up

```odin
project_clean_up :: proc(api: ^Api, undo_only: bool, cache: bool) -> (Clean_Up, Result)
```

Moves the files the project doesn't use to the Trash (from where they can be put back) and saves it: those nothing uses, and with `undo_only` the samples only undo would bring back (undo is forgotten), with `cache` the renderings. Io_Error if some couldn't be moved.

## Settings, by name

### settings_count

```odin
settings_count :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (i64, Result)
```

Settings there are (settings_name lists them).

### settings_name

```odin
settings_name :: proc(api: ^Api, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Setting `index`'s name: "section.key", as settings.ini has it ("project.tempo", "midi.sync"). Temporary.

### settings_info

```odin
settings_info :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> (Setting_Info, Result)
```

What setting `name` is: its kind, its group, its range or choices.

### settings_about

```odin
settings_about :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> (string, Result)
```

What setting `name` does, in a few words. Temporary.

### settings_choice

```odin
settings_choice :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string, index: i64) -> (string, Result)
```

Choice `index` of setting `name` ("Midi_Clock"). Temporary.

### settings_get_number

```odin
settings_get_number :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> (f64, Result)
```

Setting `name` as a number: a Bool's 0 or 1, a Choice's index (a Text's 0).

### settings_get_text

```odin
settings_get_text :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string) -> (string, Result)
```

Setting `name` as text: "true", "120", a choice's name, a folder. Temporary.

### settings_set_number

```odin
settings_set_number :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string, value: f64) -> Result
```

Sets setting `name` to `value` (a Bool: nonzero is true; a Choice: its index), applies it and saves the settings. Invalid_Argument out of its range; Io_Error if it couldn't be applied (it is put back).

### settings_set_text

```odin
settings_set_text :: proc(api: ^Api, name: string, value: string) -> Result
```

Sets setting `name` from text (a Text's words, a Choice's name, "true" or "false", a number), applies it and saves the settings.

## Changes

### subscribe

```odin
subscribe :: proc(api: ^Api, topic: Topic, index: i64, callback: Change_Proc, user: rawptr) -> (Subscription, Result)
```

Calls `callback` with `user` when `topic` changes (`index`: only for that pad, bus...; -1: all). Control thread. Unsupported for a topic this version doesn't report (see `TOPICS`).

### unsubscribe

```odin
unsubscribe :: proc(api: ^Api, sub: Subscription) -> Result
```

Stops subscription `sub`. Not_Found if there is none. Control thread (a callback may unsubscribe itself).

## Transport

### transport_state

```odin
transport_state :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (Transport_State, Result)
```

The transport now.

### transport_play

```odin
transport_play :: proc(api: ^Api, from_beat: f64 = 0, count_in: bool = false) -> Result
```

Starts playing from beat `from_beat` of what plays (the sequence shown, or the song from its cue at 0); with `count_in`, the count-in's bars of click first. Playing already, it starts again from there.

### transport_stop

```odin
transport_stop :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Stops (back to the top) and disarms Rec. Stopped already, it does nothing more.

### transport_toggle

```odin
transport_toggle :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Plays if stopped, stops if playing (the Space key).

### transport_silence

```odin
transport_silence :: proc(api: ^Api) -> Result
```

Silences every sound at once (a fade of a few milliseconds), playing or not: what pressing Stop twice does.

### transport_set_tempo

```odin
transport_set_tempo :: proc(api: ^Api, bpm: f64) -> Result
```

Sets the tempo (40..300 BPM), undoably.

### transport_tap

```odin
transport_tap :: proc(api: ^Api) -> (f64, Result)
```

One tap of tap tempo, now (the app's clock): returns the tempo the taps so far make, set (to a tenth), or 0 until there are two. The fourth tap stopped starts playing a beat later; a pause of 2 s starts again.

### transport_set_loop

```odin
transport_set_loop :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Loops (it goes round) or plays once and stops, undoably.

### transport_set_count_in

```odin
transport_set_count_in :: proc(api: ^Api, bars: i64) -> Result
```

Sets the bars of click before recording (0..2), undoably.

### transport_set_time_signature

```odin
transport_set_time_signature :: proc(api: ^Api, num: i64, den: i64) -> Result
```

Sets the time signature: `num` beats (1..16) of 1/`den` (2, 4, 8 or 16), undoably.

### transport_set_metronome

```odin
transport_set_metronome :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Turns the metronome on or off (the app's, not the project's: not undoable).

### transport_set_metronome_level

```odin
transport_set_metronome_level :: proc(api: ^Api, db: f32) -> Result
```

Sets the metronome's level (-48..6 dB), undoably.

### transport_set_metronome_sound

```odin
transport_set_metronome_sound :: proc(api: ^Api, sound: Metronome_Sound) -> Result
```

Sets the metronome's sound, undoably.

### transport_set_metronome_accent

```odin
transport_set_metronome_accent :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Accents the bar's first beat (or clicks it as the others), undoably.

### transport_set_metronome_recording_only

```odin
transport_set_metronome_recording_only :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Clicks only while recording and counting in (or always when on), undoably.

### transport_set_song_mode

```odin
transport_set_song_mode :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Plays the song (true) or the sequence shown (false: Pattern).

### transport_set_sync

```odin
transport_set_sync :: proc(api: ^Api, sync: Sync) -> Result
```

Follows `sync` for the tempo, start and stop (the setting "midi.sync": saved with the settings, not the project). Link not built in: Internal.

### transport_set_clock_out

```odin
transport_set_clock_out :: proc(api: ^Api, on: bool) -> Result
```

Sends MIDI clock to the output port, or stops (the setting "midi.clock_out").

## Types

### Result

What a call came to. `last_error` says why it wasn't `Ok`.

`Ok`, `Not_Found`, `Invalid_Argument`, `Busy`, `Unsupported`, `Io_Error`

### Setting_Kind

What a setting is (`settings_info`).

`Bool`, `Int`, `Number`, `Choice`, `Text`

### Setting_Group

What part of Pads a setting changes (applied when it is set: the audio device reopened, the MIDI ports, what the tempo follows...).

`Appearance`, `Audio`, `Midi`, `Sync`, `Recording`, `Project`, `Plugins`

### Topic

What a subscriber hears about. Topics whose module isn't built yet answer `subscribe` with `Unsupported`.

`Transport`, `History`, `Selection`, `Pad`, `Mixer`, `Sequence`, `Song`, `Launcher`, `Project`, `Settings`, `Recording`, `Ui`

### Metronome_Sound

The metronome's sound.

`Beep`, `Wood`, `Stick`, `Cowbell`

### Sync

What the tempo, start and stop follow.

`Internal`, `Midi_Clock`, `Link`

### History_State

The undo history now: steps that can be undone and redone, and whether the project has changed since it was saved.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `undo_steps` | `i64` | steps that can be undone |
| `redo_steps` | `i64` | steps undone that can be redone |
| `dirty` | `bool` | changed since it was saved |
| `grouping` | `bool` | a group is open (history_group_begin) |

### Project_State

The project now: where it is, whether it changed, the lists beside it.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `untitled` | `bool` | not saved anywhere yet (it is in the unsaved folder) |
| `dirty` | `bool` | changed since it was saved |
| `recent` | `i64` | projects in the recent list (project_recent) |
| `templates` | `i64` | templates there are (project_template_name) |

### Unused_Files

What `project_unused_files` found: files the project doesn't use, by kind, and their size.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `unused` | `i64` | files in its samples folders nothing uses |
| `unused_bytes` | `i64` |  |
| `undo_only` | `i64` | samples only undoing would bring back |
| `undo_only_bytes` | `i64` |  |
| `cache` | `i64` | renderings, made again when needed |
| `cache_bytes` | `i64` |  |

### Clean_Up

What `project_clean_up` did.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `files` | `i64` | moved to the Trash |
| `bytes` | `i64` |  |

### Setting_Info

What setting `name` is.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `Setting_Kind` |  |
| `group` | `Setting_Group` |  |
| `min` | `f64` | Int and Number |
| `max` | `f64` |  |
| `choices` | `i64` | Choice: how many (settings_choice) |

### Transport_State

The transport now. The playhead (`beat`, `timeline_beat`, the position) moves without a change being reported: poll it.

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `playing` | `bool` |  |
| `counting_in` | `bool` | playing, still before the top (the count-in) |
| `recording` | `bool` | Rec is armed |
| `song_mode` | `bool` | the song plays (else the sequence shown: Pattern) |
| `beat` | `f64` | beats into what plays (0 stopped) |
| `timeline_beat` | `f64` | beats on the timeline (negative counting in) |
| `bar` | `i64` | where it is, as a musician counts (from 1; 0 or less counting in) |
| `beat_in_bar` | `i64` | ... the beat (from 1) |
| `sixteenth` | `i64` | ... the sixteenth (from 1) |
| `bpm` | `f64` |  |
| `loop` | `bool` | it goes round (else it plays once and stops) |
| `count_in` | `i64` | bars of click before recording (0..2) |
| `time_sig_num` | `i64` |  |
| `time_sig_den` | `i64` |  |
| `metronome` | `bool` | the click is on |
| `metronome_db` | `f32` |  |
| `metronome_sound` | `Metronome_Sound` |  |
| `metronome_accent` | `bool` | the bar's first beat clicks louder |
| `metronome_recording_only` | `bool` | it clicks only while recording (and counting in) |
| `sync` | `Sync` | what the tempo follows (the setting "midi.sync") |
| `clock_out` | `bool` | MIDI clock goes out (the setting "midi.clock_out") |
